title: Elite Escape
specs: Three themed escape rooms with varying difficulty levels
Rooms include Escape From Oz, Forbidden Sands, and Playroom Pandemonium
Children aged 5 and older allowed; under 5 not admitted
Groups with minors under 18 must have a paying parent/guardian present
Groups of 2 or 3 pay $31.50 per person; groups 4 to 10 pay $29.50 per person
Large group discounts available for groups over 10; call for rates
Private rooms for your party only; no other people in the room
Facility available 7 days a week for private group events
includes: Private room for your party only
Time for fun pictures after the game
gap: Exact prices for birthday parties not stated
blurb: Guests work together to find clues, solve puzzles, and escape the room within 60 minutes. The experience includes a brief introduction, the escape attempt, and time for photos. Rooms are private and designed for adults but suitable for children aged 5 and older.
extraNote: All booking changes must be made at least 48 hours before start time · No refunds within 48 hours of start time · No refunds for rescheduled bookings even if cancelled within 48 hours · Arrive 15 minutes early for briefing · No refunds or exchanges for late arrivals
